استحققنا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَقْنَا (istaḥqaqnā) /is.taħ.qaq.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اُسْتُحْقِقْنَا (ustuḥqiqnā) /us.tuħ.qiq.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
